part.name: Open-end/box-end wrench-like lever with top pocket
part.description: Single solid, constant-thickness (15 mm) tool-like part with an open-ended C-head on one end, a circular ring/eye with through-hole on the other, and a shallow rectangular recessed pocket on the top face along the handle.
part.symmetry_note: Largely mirror-symmetric about the longitudinal center plane (X=0). Not symmetric about the mid-thickness plane (Y=7.5) due to the pocket existing only on the top face.

Section.name: Main plate faces (top & bottom)
features included: through-hole and open-jaw outlines expressed as boundary loops on the planar faces
Section.function intent: Provide the primary constant-thickness body surfaces for gripping/contact and define the overall silhouette boundaries.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as the main load-carrying web in bending/torsion across the tool thickness; distributes surface contact forces and ties all sidewalls together.
Section.geometry: Two large, parallel planar faces at Y=15 (top) and Y=0 (bottom), containing multiple boundary loops for the outer profile plus internal cutouts (ring hole, jaw slot opening, pocket opening).
Section.location: Entire part, opposing faces along thickness direction (Y).

major_faces.name: Top face
major_faces.description: Global top planar face at Y=15 with outer profile and internal loops (hole/slot/pocket opening).

major_faces.name: Bottom face
major_faces.description: Global bottom planar face at Y=0 with outer profile and internal loops (hole/slot opening).

Section.name: Handle sidewalls (rectangular shank)
Section.function intent: Transmit torque/force between the two end interfaces (open jaw and ring eye) while providing a stiff lever arm.
Section.physical behavior: Primarily resists bending and torsion along the length; planar sidewalls stabilize the web and maintain constant handle width.
Section.geometry: Two long vertical planar faces forming the left/right side boundaries of the handle region; transitions to blends at each end.
Section.location: Central long region between the ring end and open-end head (mid-length).

major_faces.name: Handle left side wall
major_faces.description: Long planar side face at approximately X=-10.09 over the handle length.

major_faces.name: Handle right side wall
major_faces.description: Long planar side face at X=+10.00 over the handle length.

Section.name: Ring/eye end (through-hole interface)
features included: box-end style interface for a round fastener/head
Section.function intent: Locate and constrain a mating cylindrical/hex feature (e.g., nut/bolt head) via the through-hole/eye, enabling torque transmission.
Section.physical behavior: Hole wall provides bearing contact; ring section carries hoop/bending stresses and transmits torque into the handle via the neck blend.
Section.geometry: Concentric cylindrical side surfaces: outer cylinder (ring OD) and inner cylinder (through-hole ID), both extruded along Y (thickness).
Section.location: One end of the part (ring end), around positive-Z region in the STEP coordinates.

major_faces.name: Ring outer cylindrical wall (OD)
major_faces.description: Outer cylindrical surface of the ring end (radius ~14.922), axis along Y.

major_faces.name: Ring inner cylindrical bore (ID)
major_faces.description: Through-hole cylindrical surface (radius 10), axis along Y; primary mating/bearing interface.

Section.name: Ring-to-handle neck blends
Section.function intent: Reduce stress concentration and smoothly transmit load from the ring end into the rectangular handle.
Section.physical behavior: Provides gradual change in section stiffness; lowers peak stresses under bending and torque by increasing local radius and reducing notch effects.
Section.geometry: Two cylindrical blend surfaces (radius ~5) on left/right sides, axis along Y, bridging the rectangular handle sidewalls to the ring geometry.
Section.location: Between ring/eye end and the main handle, near the ring end.

major_faces.name: Left ring-neck blend
major_faces.description: Cylindrical blend surface (r=5) on the left side near ring-to-handle transition.

major_faces.name: Right ring-neck blend
major_faces.description: Cylindrical blend surface (r=5) on the right side near ring-to-handle transition.

Section.name: Top recessed pocket (handle lightening/grip feature)
Section.function intent: Reduce weight and/or provide a shallow grip/label recess while keeping overall thickness and stiffness acceptable.
Section.physical behavior: Removes material locally, slightly reducing bending stiffness; vertical walls and corner fillets help manage stress concentration around the recess perimeter.
Section.geometry: Shallow rectangular pocket open to the top face: planar floor at Y=14 (1 mm deep), planar side/end walls between Y=14..15, and 1 mm radius cylindrical corner fillets.
Section.location: Centered on the top face along the handle length (mid-span between ends).

major_faces.name: Pocket floor
major_faces.description: Planar pocket bottom at Y=14 spanning most of the handle length.

major_faces.name: Pocket near-end wall
major_faces.description: Planar end wall of pocket at Z≈-6.152 (near ring side), vertical between Y=14..15.

major_faces.name: Pocket near-end right corner fillet
major_faces.description: Cylindrical corner fillet (r=1) at pocket near-end, right corner.

major_faces.name: Pocket right wall
major_faces.description: Planar side wall of pocket at X≈+6.945, vertical between Y=14..15.

major_faces.name: Pocket far-end right corner fillet
major_faces.description: Cylindrical corner fillet (r=1) at pocket far-end, right corner.

major_faces.name: Pocket far-end wall
major_faces.description: Planar end wall of pocket at Z≈-97.400, vertical between Y=14..15.

major_faces.name: Pocket far-end left corner fillet
major_faces.description: Cylindrical corner fillet (r=1) at pocket far-end, left corner.

major_faces.name: Pocket left wall
major_faces.description: Planar side wall of pocket at X≈-7.491, vertical between Y=14..15.

major_faces.name: Pocket near-end left corner fillet
major_faces.description: Cylindrical corner fillet (r=1) at pocket near-end, left corner.

Section.name: Handle-to-head shoulder blends
Section.function intent: Smoothly transition from the straight handle to the larger open-end head, reducing stress concentration under torque.
Section.physical behavior: Blend radii reduce notch sensitivity and spread bending/torsional stresses across a longer transition length.
Section.geometry: Two external cylindrical blend surfaces (radius ~5), axis along Y, on left/right sides near the head end.
Section.location: Between the main handle and the open-end head, near the head-side of the handle.

major_faces.name: Left head-shoulder blend
major_faces.description: External cylindrical blend (r=5) on left side near the head transition.

major_faces.name: Right head-shoulder blend
major_faces.description: External cylindrical blend (r=5) on right side near the head transition.

Section.name: Open-jaw internal slot (open-end interface)
Section.function intent: Locate a mating part (e.g., nut/flat feature) in the open slot, constrain its lateral motion, and transmit torque through jaw bearing surfaces.
Section.physical behavior: Jaw planes provide bearing contact; base face and fillets control stress at the slot root; resists spreading of jaws under load.
Section.geometry: Two opposing planar jaw inner faces at X=±10, a planar slot base at Z=-110, and two cylindrical internal fillets (r=5) connecting jaw faces to the base region.
Section.location: At the open-end head, internal cutout region near the far (negative-Z) end.

major_faces.name: Right jaw inner face
major_faces.description: Planar jaw face at X=+10 defining one side of the open slot.

major_faces.name: Right slot-root fillet
major_faces.description: Cylindrical internal fillet (r=5) blending right jaw face into the slot root region.

major_faces.name: Slot base face
major_faces.description: Planar face at Z=-110 forming the flat base/root of the open slot between fillets.

major_faces.name: Left slot-root fillet
major_faces.description: Cylindrical internal fillet (r=5) blending left jaw face into the slot root region.

major_faces.name: Left jaw inner face
major_faces.description: Planar jaw face at X=-10 defining the other side of the open slot.

Section.name: Open-end head outer periphery (C-head body)
Section.function intent: Provide the structural mass around the open jaws to resist bending/spreading and to transmit torque from the jaw interface into the handle.
Section.physical behavior: Carries the majority of bending stress around the jaw opening; outer arcs act as a stiff frame resisting deformation.
Section.geometry: Two large outer cylindrical side surfaces (axis along Y) forming the left/right outer arcs of the open-end head profile.
Section.location: At the open-end head (far negative-Z end), surrounding the jaw slot.

major_faces.name: Left outer head arc
major_faces.description: Large outer cylindrical side surface on left side of head (radius ~25.971), axis along Y.

major_faces.name: Right outer head arc
major_faces.description: Large outer cylindrical side surface on right side of head (radius ~25.790), axis along Y.
